content:
q07.

`web/src/connect.ts`

The ConnectRPC service clients are all created there via `createClient(...)` calls over a shared `createConnectTransport` transport (e.g. `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, etc. at `web/src/connect.ts:192-203`).
